Greywater Library Service
MARKET HALL REGULATIONS
as made on 15 June 2034

1. Opening hour. The hall opens to traders at 9:00 on trading days.

2. Deposit. A new trader pays a refundable deposit of 56 credits.

3. Generator limit. Generators above 73 decibels are not allowed in the hall.

4. Stall fee. The stall fee is 13 credits per trading day.

5. Notice of absence. A trader who will miss a trading day must give notice at least 9 days beforehand.

6. Loading window. Vehicles may load or unload for no longer than 13 minutes at the east gate.

7. Cleaning charge. A stall left unclean at closing incurs a charge of 36 credits.

8. Trader badges. Each stall holder may register up to 5 helpers' badges.

Blackthorn Valley Line
QUAYSIDE BYELAWS
as made on 25 February 2033

1. Pump-out. A vessel with a holding tank must use the pump-out station at least once every 6 days in port.

2. Maximum vessel length. No vessel longer than 13 metres may berth at the north quay.

3. Waste oil. Waste oil must be handed to the reception tank within 39 hours of arrival.

4. Speed limit. Inside the harbour limits no vessel shall exceed 9 knots.

5. Berthing fee. The fee for a visitor berth is 16 credits per night.

6. Mooring limit. A vessel may remain at a visitor berth for no more than 29 consecutive hours.

7. Quiet hours. Engines and generators shall not be run from 22:00 until 06:00 except in an emergency.

8. Crew passes. Each berthed vessel is entitled to 2 crew passes for the gate.
